name: Read player inventory
description: Observe inventory entities and associated item data at runtime.
limitations: Ownership and equipment relationships require additional validation.

name: Recipe relationships
description: Trace recipe categories, references, and source relationships.
limitations: Relationship mapping does not prove safe runtime modification.

name: Character appearance schema
description: Map appearance fields and test safe runtime observation.

name: Localization inventory
description: Inventory localization tags and inspect runtime access limitations.

name: Building voxel census
description: Inspect building voxel structures through static and runtime census work.
limitations: Census results do not establish editing support.

name: Runtime API observation
description: Inventory services and API surfaces exposed to read-only probes.
limitations: Availability may change between runtime builds.

name: Player state observation
description: Observe player state and owner context through read-only runtime probes.
limitations: Ownership boundaries and persistence behavior need further validation.

name: Item instance schema
description: Map item-instance fields and relationships without assuming write support.
limitations: Schema visibility does not establish safe item editing.

name: Blueprint field observation
description: Inspect blueprint-related fields and record runtime visibility.
limitations: Editing and persistence are not confirmed.

name: Loot pickup observation
description: Observe loot pickup structures and related runtime events.
limitations: Event coverage varies by test scenario.

name: Static tuning catalog
description: Map balancing and progression fields from curated static data.
limitations: Static fields are not proof of runtime configurability.

name: Loader compatibility scan
description: Inventory loader components, conflicts, and proposed load order.
limitations: Local scan output is environment-specific and should not be treated as universal support.

name: Resource type mapping
description: Map resource identifiers and type relationships for further research.
limitations: Mapping does not establish mutability or compatibility across builds.
